// Proxy profile: one POST to the proxy, which adds the FileMaker credentials itself.
// Replace the modId with the one from the record you read.
interface DataApiEnvelope<T> {
  response: T;
  messages: Array<{ code: string; message: string }>;
}

const host = "https://proxy.example.com";
const token = process.env.FM_PROXY_API_KEY ?? "<proxy api key>";
const authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;

async function dataApi<T>(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<DataApiEnvelope<T>> {
  const isForm = body instanceof FormData;
  const response = await fetch(`${host}${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: body === undefined || isForm ? { Authorization: authorization } : { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: authorization },
    body: body === undefined ? undefined : isForm ? body : JSON.stringify(body)
  });
  const envelope = (await response.json()) as DataApiEnvelope<T>;
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Data API request failed (${response.status}): ${envelope.messages?.map((m) => m.message).join("; ")}`);
  }
  return envelope;
}

const { response } = await dataApi<unknown>("POST", "/filemaker", {
  "action": "editRecord",
  "profile": {
    "id": "profile-proxy",
    "database": "Sales DB",
    "serverUrl": "https://fm.example.com"
  },
  "payload": {
    "layout": "Contacts",
    "recordId": "42",
    "fieldData": {
      "Status": "Inactive"
    },
    "modId": "<modId>"
  }
});
console.log(response);
